name: fillet-counts-a-split-rim-once
why: The count beside a treatment is what .expect({ count }) is pasted from, so the two must count alike. The big sphere's seam ends on the +X bead's rim in two kernel edges (docs/GOTCHAS.md, "A seam cut the rim of a bead in two"); the reply used to count those, said edges: 17, and .expect({ count: 17 }) then failed with "matched 16". 16 rims, one fillet each.
